data.name: Signal Snow
data.detailed_description:
A station built to watch storms. A signal that remembers you.


Signal Snow is a psychological horror visual novel set on Station Asterion, an isolated Antarctic weather outpost cut off by a brutal storm. When the crew detects a radio signal rising from beneath the ice, the first message is not a warning. It is a memory.

Soon, every member of the expedition begins recalling things that could not have happened to them: rooms they never entered, wounds they never received, childhoods that belong to someone else. The signal knows the station. It knows the crew. And it may know you best of all.

Choose who survives the silence


  • Interrogate crew members and compare impossible memories.
  • Track trust, panic, station integrity, signal strength, and memory contamination.
  • Decide who to isolate, who to release, and who is too useful to lock away.
  • Investigate the radio room, medbay, generator level, archive, and buried structures below the station.
  • Answer the signal, record it, sever it, or follow it under the ice.
  • Reach branching outcomes shaped by trust, evidence, fear, and command decisions.

Paranoia without easy monsters


Signal Snow is inspired by stories of isolation, contamination, and mistrust. The horror is not only what waits under the ice. It is the moment when a friend remembers your childhood better than you do, when procedure starts to sound like punishment, and when survival requires trusting someone who may already be compromised.

Content note


Signal Snow contains psychological horror, paranoia, isolation, coercive containment, medical distress, and themes of identity disruption. It does not focus on graphic gore.
